name: Reva's lightsaber
description: Reva's lightsaber also known as Reva's double-bladed Inquisitor Lightsaber, and the Third Sister's lightsaber, was a lightsaber wielded by the Jedi hunter known as the Third Sister, also known as Reva, during her service to the Galactic Empire. It was similar in appearance to other double-bladed spinning lightsabers wielded by Imperial Inquisitors. As the hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi came to an end, Reva would lay down her lightsaber, seeking to turn her back on the dark side of the Force.

data.name: Reva's lightsaber
mods: Extendable hand guard, can spin around central handle with detachable emitters locked to hand guard (disc mode)
Detachable hilt allows the user to fight with two single sabers (disconnect mode)
